items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable vs Raiders (ribs); practiced Friday after DNPs.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited return Friday
items.implication: Biggest slate Q per Levitan; impacts Herbert heavily; 4pm ET game
items.opportunity: If out: Johnston/Harris route/target bump; Herbert downgrade

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri
items.implication: HOU WR corps depleted (Higgins ACL, Dell IR); look to Noel/Hutchinson/Boutte/Schultz
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints (hamstring).
items.why: Hamstring; limited/no practice most of week
items.implication: BAL WRs thin with Lane also out; Bateman primary beneficiary

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful vs Chargers (knee); returned to limited practice Friday, pregame workout planned.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup surgery; first practice Friday
items.implication: Likely miss; Mayer elevated if out; optimistic for Week 3

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate, affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs Q with late start; cascade effects
items.opportunity: If out: LAC WR hierarchy shift to Johnston etc.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Unclear vs Stevenson but timing right with AJ Brown IR and strong matchups ahead.
items.implication: Potential flex/RB2 upside if volume comes

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; returning from prior issue
items.implication: Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; nice upcoming schedule

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow questionable (back) but he said he's playing vs HOU.
items.implication: Monitor but likely active; CIN offense intact

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ tgt share/util in debut with KC, 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches thru 3Q; IND gave 163 yds/3 TD to Henry.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches often.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; injury scare overblown

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft vs run.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Wk1; 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ Wentz; CHI soft.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Wk1, air-heavy production; Kamara return squeezes further; underdog script.
